articles.title: Overnight Road Closures Planned at Sudden Junction from October 12 to 15
articles.excerpt: Rochdale Borough Council will implement overnight road closures at Sudden Junction from October 12 to 15 for resurfacing work, affecting local traffic routes.
articles.content_html:
Rochdale Borough Council has announced that overnight road closures will take place around Sudden Junction from Monday, October 12, to Thursday, October 15. The closures are part of a resurfacing project aimed at improving road conditions in the area.

The restrictions will be in effect each night from 8pm to 5am, during which crews will resurface the road, refresh road markings, and renew traffic signs. Key routes affected include Manchester Road in Castleton, which will be closed northbound between Onslow Street and Bolton Road, impacting traffic heading towards Rochdale town centre.

Additionally, Silk Street will operate as a one-way street towards Tesco, preventing drivers from travelling from Tesco towards Manchester Road. Traffic on Bolton Road will also be restricted from turning right onto Manchester Road towards Castleton.

The council has stated that fully signed diversion routes will be in place to guide motorists during the closures. Residents and commuters are advised to plan their journeys accordingly to avoid delays.
